text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Huh, you can't get the noodles ready—!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One week left until the "Ramen Jamboree"— 
Light Hello and I visited the company 
slated to supply our noodles wholesale.

text_block_list.name: Noodle Factory Worker
text_block_list.text:
W-Well, no. I wasn't able to get flour 
from our usual supplier.

text_block_list.name: Noodle Factory Worker
text_block_list.text:
So, the texture of the noodles might be a 
little different from what we served last 
year... Would that still be okay with 
you...?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
—No, please give me the item I requested. 
That was what we promised, after all!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
If it proves difficult to arrange, we 
would appreciate it if you could let us 
know as soon as possible.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
......T-This is bad. This might be really 
bad... Even for me!
choice_data_list:
To think we wouldn't be able to use the 
same noodle factory...!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
F-For now, I'll check with various places! 
Somewhere with reliable quality...!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I see... No, I'm the one making an 
unreasonable request, so please don't 
worry about it. Excuse me, then.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: —It was a total wipeout...! Guuuuuh...!
choice_data_list:
I'm sorry, I couldn't pull it off 
either...!

I'm sorry, I wasn't able to do it 
either...!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Tazuna-san is doing what she can as well, 
...but it looks like the situation is just 
as tough for her.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Ah, sorry! Calling back... Thanks for your 
hard work! Sorry for the sudden call—

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: ...Eh, are you serious!?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
I just received word... 'Uchirachi Noodle 
Factory' has agreed to hear us out for 
now!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
"However, it seems the president is 
currently in business talks at a ramen 
shop called 'Menya Namiashi.' We don't 
have an official answer yet—"

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
"...Wait, Menya Namiashi by 18:00? 
............ If things go well, by car, 
maybe...?"

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. —Trainer! Would you mind riding in 
the passenger seat?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The current time is 17:30. 'Menya 
Namiashi' is a ramen shop out in the 
suburbs—
choice_data_list:
It'll take an hour!? Will we make it in 
time!?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Yes. I'll make sure to make it in time!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We hurriedly scramble into the orange kei 
car Light Hello had parked. After pulling 
away smoothly—

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. Back in college, I was so happy 
when I got my license that I drove around 
all the time. I'm actually a great driver!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
I need to at least get a yes or no by the 
end of the day. Based on that, our next 
move will...
choice_data_list:
Huh, we're going through here?! Can we 
even fit?!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Ah, we can easily get through here. 
Cutting through here lets us avoid the 
intersection traffic! It should save us at 
least five minutes!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Alright! We've made it out of the city 
center! At this rate... what time is it 
right now?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was brilliant. By utilizing the narrow 
back alleys, she swiftly navigated through 
the usually time-consuming city center—

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
We're here! 'Noodle Shop Namiashi'! —Boss! 
Excuse us!

text_block_list.name: Noodle Factory President
text_block_list.text: Mm? Who might you be...?

text_block_list.name: Noodle Factory President
text_block_list.text:
...I'm surprised. You sped all the way 
here in your car just to talk to me? Out 
of your way?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I want to make sure this event is a 
success! So, even a day... no, even a 
second sooner!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
I really wanted to talk with the 
president!

text_block_list.name: Noodle Factory President
text_block_list.text:
Ho...? A young person so exceptionally 
devoted to their work these days. I like 
you!

text_block_list.name: Noodle Factory President
text_block_list.text:
"Come check out our noodles tomorrow. If 
you like what you see, I'll supply them on 
the day of the event too."

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: ――! Th-Thank you so much!
choice_data_list: Thank you very much! That's a huge help!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the day of the "Ramen Jamboree" 
arrived.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
This is our second time doing this event! 
Drawing from our past experience, let's do 
our best to deliver even more gratitude! 
Ei, ei, jamboree!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Um... Huh? What was it again... I feel 
like there was still something I had to 
do.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, Ms. Hello! Do you know where 
the menu is?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! The menu! I'm so sorry! I'll go 
get it right away!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Um, I hope it's just my imagination, 
but... Hello-san, aren't you tired today?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
N-No! Not at all! I ate ramen, so I'm full 
of energy! See?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Is that so...? Well, if you say so, then 
it's fine, but...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you for all your hard work 
preparing. You really pushed yourself 
quite hard, didn't you?
choice_data_list:
That's right, even after the noodle 
factory was decided—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She visited the noodle factory time and 
time again to check on the quality of the 
noodles. She did so even at the expense of 
her own sleep.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... Maybe I pushed myself a little 
too hard. Still—that doesn't matter to the 
audience, does it?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
"'Things didn't work out because problems 
came up.' Excuses like that won't fly 
here."

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
At the end of the day, the "results" 
produced are everything. —That is what 
live events are all about.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
...It's harsh, isn't it? But that's just 
the reality. I did the best that I could. 
Because—

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Because I didn't want everything they've 
built up to go to waste.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
"Fine-san and the others have put in 
undeniable effort. Our job is to deliver 
that without excess or deficiency."

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
So, I really didn't have any choice but to 
do something about it... Ahaha.
choice_data_list:
...I think that's a wonderful attitude to 
have!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Yes, truly... I want to follow her example 
as well!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Just make sure you don't push yourself too 
hard "all on your own," okay? When the 
signal turns red, please rely on us, 
alright?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. I'll go taste the soup one more 
time. I want to properly live up to 
everyone's hard work!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Right... Pouring Hello-san's feelings into 
the bowl as well—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Let's do our best! At the 2nd Ramen 
Jamboree!
